title: Relink: Constructing Query-Driven Evidence Graph On-the-Fly for GraphRAG
authors: Manzong Huang; Chenyang Bu; Yi He; Xingrui Zhuo; Xindong Wu
why_relevant: Relink targets distractor facts and missing evidence in GraphRAG by dynamically constructing query-specific evidence graphs, directly addressing noisy retrieval and distraction in graph-based RAG.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on GraphRAG performance gains rather than systematic robustness evaluation; conflict/adversarial aspects not addressed.
suggested_section: Distraction and Noisy Retrieval in GraphRAG
